scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of commercial and residential structures. The street is lined with trees and has a pedestrian crossing area with white markings. A man walks across the street while another person rides a bicycle. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The left side of the street features a modern building with balconies and a flat roof, while the right side has a more traditional building with a pitched roof and a clock tower. Both have multiple stories and appear to be made of concrete and brick.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines marking the pedestrian crossing area. The sidewalk is made of concrete and has a few trees planted along its length.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and bike racks along the sidewalk, as well as a few trash cans.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are leafy and well-maintained, providing shade for pedestrians.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a large red sign on the left side of the street.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet, with only a few people visible.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is a busy route for commuters, with many people traveling to work or school.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is a popular spot for tourists, with many shops and restaurants catering to visitors.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is a great place to study or work, with many students and professionals in the area.
